t_mix.semantics: Measured mixture temperature at some point in the pipeline (inlet, outlet, or intermediate — exact meaning unresolved per src/temporal.py comment line 67). NOT a computed field.
t_mix.qa_applied: zero_temperature_during_flow rule (soft, 3-day persistence); low/high threshold rules

t_start.semantics: Measured temperature at pipe inlet. NOT computed.

t_end.semantics: Measured temperature at pipe outlet. NOT computed.

t_mix_usable.semantics: Copy of t_mix after QA; set to NaN where rule 'zero_temperature_during_flow' fires AND row is NOT part of a 3-consecutive-day persistent run

t_mix_mean.semantics: Daily-median then equal-weight mean of t_mix_usable over all observation days < cutoff, computed by src/temporal.py::hydraulic_summary(). Single scalar per pipe per cutoff — NOT segment-resolved.

t_start_mean.semantics: Time-average of t_start_usable. Single scalar per pipe per cutoff.

t_end_mean.semantics: Time-average of t_end_usable. Single scalar per pipe per cutoff.

temperature_c_mean.semantics: Segment-resolved temperature estimate via Shukhov exponential decay profile when t_start_mean and t_end_mean both available; linear fallback if ratios invalid; pipe-level t_mix_mean fallback if no boundary temps; hardcoded 20.0 if all missing.
temperature_c_mean.ground_temp_c: 4.0 is a fallback constant (soil reference), NOT a measurement
temperature_c_mean.fillna_20: fillna(20.0) is a code fallback, NOT a measurement

arrhenius_thermal_factor.formula: exp(theta * (1/T_ref - 1/T_K)), theta=2500 K (LEGACY PLACEHOLDER), T_ref=293.15 K
arrhenius_thermal_factor.note: theta=2500 K is explicitly a legacy placeholder per spec; team-proposed candidates are Ea={0,25,40,55,70} kJ/mol

1250009583_cold_start_2022-07-01.shukhov_path: exponential (ratio=0.1737, spatially varying — large gradient inlet to outlet)
1250009583_cold_start_2022-07-01.note: 74% of total life is unobserved (pre-2015). Observed window 2015-2022 has good T coverage (1414/1414 days). Arrhenius varies meaningfully (0.67–1.03) along pipe.

1250022871_between_vtd_2023-12-01.note: 12.6 years pre-obs gap. Observed 2013-2023 has good T coverage (2765/2771 days with t_mix valid). Arrhenius barely varies (1.108–1.114) — essentially constant spatially.

qa_actions_temperature.note: Zero t_mix during no-flow (q_liquid=0): 185 rows — these are NOT removed (zero flow, sensor may read ambient). Legitimate 0 C readings at no-flow are preserved.

celsius_to_kelvin.clip_in_arrhenius: lower=253.15 K (-20 C) — no rows affected

rows_lost_T_valid_but_wv_missing.note: Only 1 row has t_mix_usable valid but v_liquid_true_usable missing. T-only experiment loses virtually no data vs T+W+v.

spatial_variation.1250009583_cold_start: SIGNIFICANT (std=3.94 C, range 13.97 C) — Shukhov exponential, good for Arrhenius experiment
spatial_variation.1250022871_between_vtd: MINIMAL (std=0.052 C, range 0.18 C) — nearly isothermal pipe

temperature_only_experiment_feasibility.gap_risk: cold_start has 74% pre-obs gap and max 398-day intra-obs gap. Under bounded_hold_1_day policy, pre-obs gap is UNKNOWN, not filled.
